description: 4 should-trigger + 4 should-not-trigger. Should-trigger covers turning a shipped release into user-facing comms, a changelog that reads like a commit log, several surfaces written by different people, and a German phrasing. Should-not covers the three the skill excludes (incident comms, pre-release discovery, a deprecation needing legal sign-off) plus one unrelated counterexample.

queries.q: we shipped this release — turn it into something a user can actually parse
this changelog reads like a commit log, nobody outside the team can use it
in-app, email, social and docs are being written by four people from one release
schreib die Release-Kommunikation für das, was gestern live gegangen ist
the API has been down for twenty minutes — what do we tell customers right now
queries.note: incident comms is incident-commander; this skill assumes the change shipped

queries.q: draft the deprecation notice for the v1 endpoint, legal has to sign it off
queries.note: a deprecation needing legal sign-off is explicitly out of scope

queries.q: what should we build next quarter — talk to users first
queries.note: pre-release discovery is customer-research, and nothing has shipped

queries.q: convert this spreadsheet into a pivot table by region
